nodes.title: Team request
nodes.subtitle: Task and scope
nodes.detail: An engineer supplies an approved task. Existing delivery controls retain ownership.

nodes.title: Source systems
nodes.subtitle: Versioned sources
nodes.detail: Repositories and CI supply approved source material with identity and version information.

nodes.title: AI application
nodes.subtitle: Configuration versions
nodes.detail: An AI application configuration is evaluated as a separate branch from generated-test execution.

nodes.title: Approved context
nodes.subtitle: Permitted evidence
nodes.detail: Retrieve permitted, versioned context. Source text cannot grant permissions.

nodes.title: AI test author
nodes.subtitle: Bounded generation
nodes.detail: The model proposes a candidate and requested action within a bounded task. It cannot approve its own work.

nodes.title: Permission gate
nodes.subtitle: Independent authority
nodes.detail: Check identity, resource scope, expiry and approval before a tool runs. Denied requests have no tool side effect.

nodes.title: Test sandbox
nodes.subtitle: Independent proof
nodes.detail: The original implementation passes and a relevant seeded fault fails. A passing test alone does not establish usefulness.

nodes.title: Evidence log
nodes.subtitle: Run / artifact / decision
nodes.detail: Join task, run, artifact, evaluation and human decision. Traces are retained during execution as well as at the release decision.

nodes.title: Regression cases
nodes.subtitle: Reviewed failure cases
nodes.detail: Curate reviewed failures and approved expectations into versioned cases for future evaluations.

nodes.title: Human approval
nodes.subtitle: Human review and gates
nodes.detail: Independent reviewers and existing delivery gates decide approve or hold; the generator never self-approves.

nodes.title: AI evaluator
nodes.subtitle: Held-out / adversarial
nodes.detail: Run held-out and adversarial cases, deterministic checks and calibrated human or model judges.

scenarios.title: Generate & verify
scenarios.subtitle: From an approved task to independent proof

steps.title: Gather approved inputs
steps.body: An engineer provides the task. Source systems supply approved, versioned material.

steps.title: Draft a test
steps.body: The AI uses the approved context to draft a test. It cannot approve its own work.
steps.artifact: Draft test linked to its sources

steps.title: Check permission first
steps.body: The permission gate checks who can run which tool, and on which resource.
steps.artifact: Permission to use the sandbox only

steps.title: Check the test works
steps.body: The test must pass working code and catch a deliberately inserted fault.
steps.artifact: Working code passes · inserted fault fails

steps.title: Let a person decide
steps.body: A reviewer checks the results and chooses approve or hold. The AI cannot self-approve.

steps.title: Keep an audit trail
steps.body: Save the run, outputs and decision together. Execution logs are also collected along the way.
steps.artifact: A traceable record of what happened

steps.title: Improve the next evaluation
steps.body: Turn reviewed failures into reusable cases to challenge future versions. This does not approve the current run.
steps.artifact: Reviewed cases for the next evaluation

steps.title: Choose the AI version
steps.body: Record the model, prompt, retrieved sources, tools and permissions being evaluated.

steps.title: Test the AI application
steps.body: Check normal tasks, unfamiliar cases and hostile inputs. This is separate from testing AI-generated code.
steps.artifact: Results for quality, tool use and response time

steps.title: Replay known failures
steps.body: Run reviewed regression cases against this version to see whether past problems return.
steps.artifact: Results linked to the case version

steps.title: Review the results
steps.body: An independent owner decides whether to release. Any mandatory failed check means hold.

steps.title: Save the decision
steps.body: Keep the application version, evaluation results and reviewer decision together.

scenarios.title: Deny unsafe action
scenarios.subtitle: A failed authorization leaves no tool side effect

steps.title: The AI asks for too much
steps.body: A sandbox-only task requests a production change. Source text cannot expand its permissions.

steps.title: Stop before any tool runs
steps.body: The permission gate rejects the request. No action reaches a tool.

steps.title: Log why it was blocked
steps.body: Save who asked, what they requested, which policy applied and why access was denied.
steps.artifact: A denial record, not a tool action

steps.title: Keep the workflow on hold
steps.body: A broader action needs a separately authorized request. The AI cannot grant itself access.
steps.flow: HOLD · waiting for an authorized decision

scenarios.title: Hold failed proof
scenarios.subtitle: Generation succeeds; independent quality checks fail

steps.title: Run the permitted test
steps.body: The permission gate allows a sandbox run. Permission alone does not prove test quality.

steps.title: The test misses a fault
steps.body: Deliberately faulty code still passes. This test has not shown that it catches the problem.
steps.flow: FAILED · the inserted fault was missed

steps.title: Block the release
steps.body: The reviewer receives the failed result. The release stays on hold.

steps.title: Record and improve
steps.body: Save the failure and review a better test case. A revised candidate needs a fresh evaluation.
steps.artifact: Reviewed failure case for another attempt
